Estimated served energy, by item:

| Item | Energy (kcal) | Protein (g) | Carbs (g) | Fat (g) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 fried eggs | ~270 | 19 | 1 | 21 |
| 2 slices toast, no butter visible | ~190 | 7 | 34 | 2 |
| Medium banana | ~105 | 1.3 | 27 | 0.4 |
| Strawberries, ~80 g | ~25 | 0.5 | 6 | 0.2 |
| Greek yogurt, 150 g, all natural | ~180 | 7 | 9 | 13 |
| Grilled tomato | ~30 | 1 | 4 | 1.5 |
| Mushrooms | ~20 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| **Total** | **~820** | **~38** | **~82** | **~39** |

The fat estimate for the eggs, tomato and mushrooms assumes they were cooked in some oil.

I can't tell from one photo what will be left over. I assumed a small amount, about 60 kcal, from part of the banana or yogurt. That leaves about 760 kcal eaten, with macros scaled down to match.
